# Zhihua Moulds

> Chinese factory-direct manufacturer of plastic moulds for precast concrete. 10+ years experience, 50,000 m² production facility, 1,000+ mould SKUs, exporting to 30+ countries in the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa, CIS, Latin America, Europe and Oceania.

Zhihua Moulds (Jiaxing Zhihua Technology Co., Ltd., 嘉兴市志华科技股份有限公司) manufactures injection-moulded plastic moulds used by precast concrete factories worldwide to cast manhole covers, kerbstones, pavers, drainage channels, cable trenches, slope protection blocks, photovoltaic pier bases, rail transit components and custom OEM parts.

## Key Facts

- Location: No. 399, Yongkang Road, Shendang Industrial Park, Haiyan County, Jiaxing City, Zhejiang Province, China 314300
- Founded: 2015
- Employees: approximately 50
- Facility area: approximately 50,000 m²
- Mould SKUs: 1,000+ standard designs plus unlimited custom OEM
- Export markets: 30+ countries
- Materials: Polypropylene (PP), ABS, PE
- Typical mould service life: 300+ concrete pour cycles per mould
- OEM: from drawings, sample photos, or physical samples
- Lead time: typically 15-30 days after design approval
- Container loading: 20'/40' standard, flat-rack, open-top; mixed-SKU shipments supported
- Contact: +86-166-2139-1202 (WhatsApp / phone), 354909745@qq.com (email), t.me/jiexikauk (Telegram)

## Product Categories

- [Manhole Cover, Well Cover & Inspection Well Brick Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/manhole-cover-moulds): square covers, rectangular covers, round sewer covers, well frames, well bricks, circular well-brick systems
- [Kerbstone / Curbstone Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/kerbstone-moulds): arc side stone, L-type, S-type, isolation barrier, line side stone, slope water-blocking kerbstone
- [Concrete Paver Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/paver-block-moulds): interlocking blocks, grass pavers, decorative paving slabs
- [Drainage Channel / Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/drainage-channel-moulds): U-drain, drainage cover, ditch slab, catch basin
- [Cable Trench Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/cable-trench-moulds): U-shaped cable duct, utility trench, cover, double-slot
- [Slope Protection Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/slope-protection-moulds): revetment, river bank, canal lining, ecological block
- [Stepped Slope Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/stepped-slope-block-moulds): Half-I and I-shaped blocks for embankment revetment
- [Hollow / Interlocking Slope Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/hollow-interlocking-slope-block-moulds): ecological, dovetail, grass-planting revetment
- [Photovoltaic Pier Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/photovoltaic-pier-moulds): solar-panel support-base and foundation pier
- [Rail Transit Concrete Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/rail-transit-concrete-moulds): railway fence beams, bridge railing sections, roadbed protection
- [Power Engineering Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/power-engineering-moulds): cable trench coping, corner and curved coping, transformer platform coping, cobblestone combination moulds, ground anchors
- [Diamond Pattern Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/diamond-pattern-drainage-cover-moulds): anti-slip drainage cover slabs
- [Dot Pattern Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/dot-pattern-drainage-cover-moulds): textured sidewalk, drainage, municipal cover slabs
- [Hollow Block & Hexagon Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/hollow-block-hexagon-moulds): hollow blocks, hollow hexagon, flat hex pavers
- [Custom Precast Concrete Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/custom-precast-concrete-moulds): OEM from drawings or samples in ABS, PP or PE
